PSA: If you miss the tax deadline, there’s always the “I’m trapped in outer space” extension.

Yes - this actually happened. Astronaut Jack Swigert forgot to file his taxes before the Apollo 13 mission. 

But it turns out the IRS offers a little grace when you’re 200,000 miles from Earth in a crippled spacecraft.

Swigert later won election to Congress as a Republican - but died of cancer just days before taking office.

RIP to a true American explorer.
